decisions.reason: The multi-model LHD loader line is a heavily invested, publicly announced pillar of the firm's underground mining direction, and long mining sales cycles let management attribute any weak results to temporary market conditions such as the pandemic.
The underground dump trucks complement the loaders within the same committed mining strategy, so sunk development costs and the need to justify the 2018 launch favour persisting.

The construction site dumper builds on the firm's vehicle engineering and fits its construction positioning, and with no evidence of failure, disappointing sales can be blamed on the temporary pandemic slowdown in construction.
The inclined furniture lift line was visibly committed with its own web pages and several models, so management would rather persist through temporary weakness than write off the investment.
The building material lift line serves the strong construction market and reflects a visible, multi-model commitment that management will keep justifying.

The truck-mounted furniture lift is a single niche model with a dedicated page, and its link to the furniture lift family and the costs already incurred make keeping it the likely choice despite its smaller scale.
